scope: Real Weasel Client, PipeChannel, IPC Server and RimeWithWeasel handler in separate processes, with the fixed x86 Rime/Lua DLL. Headless and isolated; no TSF registration or desktop input.

checks.name: ordinary Weasel responses carry candidates and the study capability
IPC inspection preserves composition and exposes the complete definition
IPC English commit reaches the standard Weasel commit response exactly once
retransmitting a consumed ticket cannot duplicate committed English
typing continues through IPC after an English commit
editing pinyin invalidates an outstanding IPC ticket
paging rejects the previous ticket and binds the current page
current-page IPC action commits that page's full English
returning to the original page does not revive an old IPC ticket
selection changes invalidate the old ticket and preserve the selected target
long English survives IPC serialization without an ellipsis
learning-off IPC action disables English without changing Chinese composition
turning learning back on does not reactivate an old ticket
missing definitions are unavailable through the actual IPC action
an inactive session cannot accept an old English ticket
focus restoration requires a fresh ticket
another client cannot use a ticket from the first session
recreating a session rejects its predecessor's ticket
inspection never drains a pending Chinese commit from the application
keyboard and IPC English actions share the same Lua commit behavior
malformed and unsupported IPC frames cannot trigger English actions
header-only IPC frames cannot replay a previous request body or response
client decoder rejects missing capabilities duplicate states and incomplete replies
concurrent pipe connections keep their request and response bodies isolated
partial composition cannot lose remaining pinyin through IPC
service restart rejects a ticket from the previous process
a fresh ticket still commits after the service restart

verification_note: The same service binary passed all checks. Earlier successful cases are retained with their client binary hashes; the candidate-selection display assertion was corrected and only that case and restart were rerun.
limits: No Windows input method installed or registered
No live TSF client or application compatibility coverage
No production toolbar, settings or animation coverage
Runs x86 clients and service; x64 TSF integration remains pending
